question: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of “alleviate” as used in the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Relieve.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"alleviate"** means:

 
 
• To make something less severe or relieve it. (कम करना या राहत देना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The medication helped to alleviate the patient's pain.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured her a perfect score.
 
• CopyCopy

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Relieve**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Worsen** (बिगाड़ना): To make something worse or more severe.

 
 
• **Example:** Ignoring the problem will only worsen the situation.
 
 
 
• **Increase** (बढ़ाना): To make something larger in quantity, degree, or level.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to increase its production next year.
 
 
 
• **Prolong** (लंबा करना): To extend the duration of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Stress can prolong recovery time after surgery.
 
 

44:Tc1a,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Reactive.</p&
